goals: Locally authored portable contract; no upstream source is copied and no upstream license is required.
Small native islands have different overlapping masks through three independent async roots; the explicit size policy clusters their availability.
Fetching the merged availability file never co-activates its other members; shared captures, root function identity and live state survive.
A separate failed member caches thrown undefined across repeated and concurrent source uses.
Rust ownership, threshold and config tests separately prove actual merging and final typed artifact requests.
